title: Ozero Mail
lost: This letter got lost. Back to the inbox
statsText: This site counts visits without cookies.
description: Ozero Mail: one calm inbox for all your email on Android and iOS. No AI reading your mail, no subscription.
h1: All your email. One calm inbox.
sub: I’m making the mail app I couldn’t find for myself. Native, fast and free of AI.

pains.a: Gmail, Outlook, iCloud and work mail in one list, like in Apple Mail. Each account keeps its color, and every swipe answers at once.
Nobody. No AI, no ads, no tracking. Mail goes from your provider straight to your phone, my servers never see it.

pains.q: Real letters lost in the noise?
pains.a: People come first. Newsletters and notifications wait in their own tabs, sorted by simple rules on your phone.
Just me, Khizri, a designer and developer. The app is free forever; extras are a one-time purchase that pays me, not a corporation.

soon: Ozero Mail is still in the works. I answer every letter myself. Write, and I’ll tell you on launch day.
mailSubj: Tell me when Ozero Mail is out
mailBody: Hi! Write me once, on launch day.
calm: All clear. That’s how the app should feel.
name: Khizri
tip: Swipe a letter left or tap Done to clear it.
tipMouse: Drag a letter left by its subject or press Done. Keys: E for Done, U to undo.
cFine: Opens your mail app. Your address stays in my inbox and nowhere else.
